description: Rotate credentials or enable/disable an integration. set_delivery_options changes delivery_scope, renewal_event or both on a Meta or TikTok integration, in any status, without touching its credential or status; give at least one of the two.

action.description: rotate replaces the credential (send credential). disable stops delivery. enable starts it, once every one of the eight event families has a sender. set_delivery_options changes delivery_scope, renewal_event or both.

connection_id.description: The integration id, as returned by list_integrations.

credential.description: The new credential for rotate, in create_integration's format: a JSON object written as a string. Stored encrypted and never returned.

delivery_scope.description: Which events a Meta or TikTok integration sends. all (the API's default): the events of every install with measurement consent, organic ones included. attributed: send only events of installs AttriKit attributes to this connection's network (click ID, link token, or a Matched install at or above the delivery floor); others are suppressed with attributed_only_suppressed. Meta and TikTok only: a Google integration refuses attributed.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact mutation.

owners.description: Read by enable: the sender (attrkit, revenuecat or customer) of some or all event families, merged over the saved ones. Every family must end up with a sender, or the API rejects the call.

renewal_event.description: How a renewal reaches Meta website and TikTok web events. purchase (the API's default): as Purchase with its price and currency. custom: as the custom event subscription_renewed with its price and currency, so Purchase counts one-time purchases only. App events are unchanged. A Google integration refuses custom.

title: Update an ad-network integration
